question: Two circles of radii 12 cm and 13 cm are concentric. The length of the chord of the larger circle which touches the smaller circle is:
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the circles are 12cm and 13 cm 

**Concept used:**

Using Pythagoras theorem 

**Formula used:**

Hypotaneus² = Height² + Base² 

**Calculation: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70a9cc220e814811cf3f8e68a18d5f134d5ae20729a9748e8c6481386b5b6ae8.png] 

 The length of the AP is

⇒ √(13² - 12²) 

⇒ √25 = 5 cm

The length of the chord(AB) of the larger circle which touches the smaller circle is,

⇒ 5 × 2 = 10 cm

**∴ The correct option is 3**
